title: An issue's head
description: An issue's data, fenced json right below its heading; the issue index is generated from the heads.

id.description: The prefix and the number as the file name and the index write it, a leading zero included; a sub-issue's is its parent's, a dot and a number from 1.

title.description: The issue's name, as its heading repeats it: one line, no leading or trailing space.

state.description: A state of the repository's workflow.yml, checked against that file.

size.description: The size from Analyzed on, or a dash before it.

priority.description: How soon it is wanted, as Jira says it; within a state, the index lists the higher first.

rank.description: The order within one priority of one state, the lower first.

blockedBy.description: The issues this one waits on, each once: ids of the same repository, and in porelo-project also <repository>#<id> of another.

covers.description: What the index row says it covers, in one line.

parent.description: A sub-issue's parent: the id before its dot.

severity.description: How much harm a defect does, as Jira says it.

openQuestions.description: How many questions wait on the operator, counted in the Analyzed table.

worker.description: Who works the issue: an agent, or a person by hand.

risk.description: How much the issue risks: harm, ordinary or small. The planner reads an absent risk as ordinary.
